title: 后台字段选择控件读的 /api/v1/objects/:name/fields 没有服务端路由：补路由或下掉控件（接 #37225）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding S3d of the seat's L2 on PR #37489 (#37225), record 7187820695; the seat asked the owning zone to card it under #37225. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · reach: the metadata-admin field-selector widget, if any form declares it · evidence: L2 record 7187820695; os-dev report 7187574466.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：后台元数据表单的「字段选择」控件读 /api/v1/objects/:name/fields，但服务端没有注册这个路由，也没有表单用这个控件。要么补路由，要么删掉这个休眠控件。
- 谁受益：维护代码的人；以后有人启用这个控件时不会拿到 404。
- 不做会怎样：一段没人能用的代码继续留着，启用即坏。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx` `fetchFieldSelectorOptions` reads `/api/v1/objects/:name/fields`; no server route registers it and no form in either tree declares the widget (read-only inference in the #37225 dev report).
- Confirm by census, then either point it at the route that serves an object's fields or retire the widget.

## Acceptance

- The widget reads a served route (pinned), or it is removed with its tests.

Blocked-by: #37225
